title: Separate dataset acceptance from extraction and delivery workers
summary: Separated Agora interaction evidence acceptance into strict admit-only persistence from leased background extraction and delivery workers. Enforced privacy consent, raw conversation minimization, credential redaction, crash recovery, and single-item ordered downstream handoff acknowledgement.

acceptance_verification.ac1_admit_only_atomic_persistence: POST /bff/agora/interaction-evidence returns immediately after persisting to durable inbox/outbox and returning an admission receipt without invoking process_inbox or waiting for worker completion.
acceptance_verification.ac2_leased_worker_extraction_and_deliver: Separately leased background workers claim batches, validate consent, purpose, retention, and redaction, create immutable DatasetVersion records, and publish durable handoffs to the existing handoff path.
acceptance_verification.ac3_ordered_single_item_ack: POST /bff/agora/dataset-worker/handoffs/{handoff_id}/ack performs single-item ordered acknowledgement with exact dataset_version_id verification without bulk-acking historical rows, supporting both string and dictionary downstream refs from policy-learning drainer L12-MFC-R4-AGORA-001.
acceptance_verification.ac4_privacy_consent_and_redaction: Enforces explicit consent and raw conversation minimization; sensitive tokens (passwords, tokens, api keys, secrets, credit cards) are automatically sanitized to [REDACTED]; zero private user payload leaks into logs, traces, or audit records.
acceptance_verification.ac5_crash_recovery_and_isolation: Proves crash recovery before and after dataset creation, lease expiration reclamation, duplicate replay idempotency, DLQ replay, and complete multi-tenant isolation.
acceptance_verification.test_suite: 80 passed, 4 skipped in dataset extraction and integration pytest suite; 106 passed in policy-learning suite.
